        CAST(tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' AS numeric) / 100.0 as spoofprob_norm,
        CAST(tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore' AS numeric) / 100.0 as frontscore_norm,
        -- qstuffindex is already 0-1, so MinMaxScale = identity
        CAST(tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex' AS numeric) as qstuff_norm,
        -- Map washsus to numeric
        CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus'

        END as washsus_norm,

        CASE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind'
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0.0
            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
            WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END as layerind_norm,

    FROM transactionrecord tr
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    WHERE tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' IN ('Confirmed', 'Suspected')
